newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BUDAPEST BOURSE SUSPENDS TRADING IN HAJDUTEJ.
newsitem.headline: BUDAPEST BOURSE SUSPENDS TRADING IN HAJDUTEJ.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Friday it suspended trading in dairy firm Hajdutej shares for the day following a report by daily newspaper Magyar Hirlap.
The report said that Dutch dairy firm Friesland Dairy Foods Holding N.V. plans to take over another Dutch dairy company Nutricia 's stake in Hajdutej Rt.
Nutricia currently holds a 79.6 percent stake in Hajdutej and plans to boost it to 96.7 percent by the end of the year, the report added.
"Disregarding whether it is true or not, the newspaper's information could influence investors in their invesment decisions," the bourse's statement said.
The statement added that Nutricia on Thursday informed the BSE about its plans.
The BSE contacted Hajdutej, requesting information about the report in Magyar Hirlap and to confirm Nutricia's information.
Hajdutej is expected to inform the BSE still on Friday and will publish the information in the bourse's official gazette.
Hajdutej, one of the most illiquid stocks of the BSE, closed at 900 forints on November 14, the last day when its shares were traded.
